register_scripts_purpose: register-p0p1/p2p3/part3/netnew.mjs shell-loop `speckiwi add-requirement` + `add-trace` to bulk-register 50+ v3 requirements, each with multi-value AC and depends_on links resolved from titles to freshly-minted IDs in a two-phase pass.
